top_signals.title: Russia Extends Jet Fuel Export Ban to March on Refinery Attacks
top_signals.summary: Russia extended a ban on most jet fuel exports by four months through March to keep its domestic market supplied as Ukraine continues to attack the country’s refineries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Kospi Rout Wipes $151 Billion From Korea Pension Fund’s Assets
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s National Pension Service saw its assets shrink by about 202 trillion won ($151.4 billion) in the third quarter as a stock-market retreat eroded some of the out-sized gains accumulated earlier this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
